description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View called VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView, which provides a user interface for managing wake word trigger phrases in an app. It handles displaying, editing, adding, resetting, and saving trigger words, as well as synchronizing changes with an app model.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for configuring wake word trigger phrases in the app.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Appends an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if list is empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Creates a binding to a specific trigger word at a given index for UI editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves current trigger words, sanitizes them, cancels existing sync tasks, and starts a new sync task to update the app model.
